minimalFunctionBudget.rationale: Resist component laundry-listing from 26 triangulated procedures — function budget must not expand toward component count

hv_generation.definition: Generation and conditioning of the electrical energy required for microwave generation — not the individual HV components.
hv_generation.diagnosticSeparability: A failure in the HV generation chain can exist while the RF/cavity path is intact. Service procedures demonstrate this separability.
hv_generation.discoveryDecision: KEEP SPLIT — causal relationship does not collapse distinct diagnostic domains

rf_cavity.definition: Functional energy-delivery and containment domain for microwave RF energy — not a synonym for the physical cavity enclosure.
rf_cavity.diagnosticSeparability: The HV system can produce expected behavior while RF energy is not being delivered correctly. Service procedures demonstrate this separability.
rf_cavity.discoveryDecision: KEEP SPLIT — protects ontology from physical-component modeling during normalization

thermal_protection.definition: Cross-manufacturer protective thermal network function — LG TCO/thermistor and Samsung multi-TCO topologies are implementation realizations.
thermal_protection.discoveryDecision: Single canonical function — device locations, thresholds, and topology belong in overlays/platform knowledge

control_and_sensing.definition: Cook-control environmental sensing when platform implements sensor-cook paths.
control_and_sensing.discoveryDecision: CONDITIONAL — recurrent evidence but insufficient to assert humidity/cabinet sensing is universal to all microwaves

ventilation_otr.definition: Over-range ventilation function when OTR configuration applies.
ventilation_otr.discoveryDecision: CONDITIONAL — must not become canonical requirement for countertop/built-in microwave

hvRfCausalChain.note: control_board enables hv_generation; hv_generation excites rf_cavity — each remains independently diagnosable
